**5. Subsidy Assessment and Disbursement Status**

This section summarises the capital subsidy support extended under the Gujarat Solar Power Policy 2021 (as amended) for grid-connected rooftop and ground-mounted installations commissioned during the calendar year 2024. The figures presented below are based on the consolidated claim files received from nodal DISCOMs and the online portal submissions up to 15 March 2025. **5.1 General Subsidy Framework**

For installations of 10 kWp and above, the prevailing policy provides for a capital subsidy of 30% of the benchmark project cost, subject to the ceiling prescribed in the policy provisions. GEDA policy states Gujarat Energy Development Agency subsidy_rate_percent as 30%. Record status: current. This rate is current and has been applicable to all eligible projects sanctioned since 01 April 2023; no revision has been announced as of the date of this report. The subsidy is released in a single tranche upon successful commissioning and energisation of the plant, subject to verification of the installation by the concerned DISCOM and submission of the requisite documents.

For smaller residential systems below 10 kWp, the Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana framework is applicable, where the central financial assistance is provided separately.
